name: Deus Ex Machina
description: 0 Gene Pool. Stabilize. Crisis averted.
worldsEnd: Draw a card. Add its face value to your final score. Then discard it.

name: Overpopulation
description: +1 Gene Pool. Draw 1 card for every empty space in your trait pile.
worldsEnd: +4 points to the player(s) with the fewest traits in their trait pile.

name: Glacial Meltdown
description: -1 Gene Pool. Discard 2 cards from your hand at random.
worldsEnd: Discard 1 blue trait from your trait pile at random.

name: Mega Tsunami
description: -1 Gene Pool. Pass your hand to the right.
worldsEnd: Discard 1 red trait from your trait pile at random.

name: The Four Horsemen
description: -1 Gene Pool. Discard 1 trait from your trait pile.
worldsEnd: Discard 1 trait from your trait pile with a face value of 4 or higher.

name: The Big One
description: -1 Gene Pool. Give 1 card from your hand to the opponents on your left and right.
worldsEnd: -2 to your score for each color missing from your trait pile.

name: Ice Age
description: -1 Gene Pool. Discard 1 card from your hand for every red trait in your trait pile.
worldsEnd: -1 for every red trait in your trait pile.

name: Grey Goo
description: 0 Gene Pool. Discard your hand and stabilize.
worldsEnd: -5 points to the player(s) with the most traits in their trait pile.

name: Mass Extinction
description: -1 Gene Pool. Discard 1 card from your hand for every colorless trait in your trait pile.
worldsEnd: Discard 1 green trait from your trait pile.

name: Super Volcano
description: -1 Gene Pool. Discard 1 card from your hand for every blue trait in your trait pile.
worldsEnd: -1 for every blue trait in your trait pile.

name: AI Takeover
description: -1 Gene Pool. Discard all but 1 card from your hand.
worldsEnd: Each colorless trait is now worth 2. Ignore all colorless trait effects. Excluding dominants.

name: Bioengineered Plague
description: -1 Gene Pool. Each player chooses a color. The player on your left discards all cards of that color from their hand.
worldsEnd: Discard 1 random trait from your highest color count from your trait pile. If 2 or more colors are tied, pick 1.

name: Nuclear Winter
description: -2 Gene Pool. Stabilize.
worldsEnd: Discard 1 colorless trait from your trait pile.

name: Solar Flare
description: -1 Gene Pool. Discard half your hand rounded up.
worldsEnd: -1 for every purple trait in your trait pile.

name: Pulse Event
description: -1 Gene Pool. Discard 1 card from your hand for every purple trait in your trait pile.
worldsEnd: Discard 1 purple trait from your trait pile.

name: Retrovirus
description: -1 Gene Pool. Discard 1 card from your hand for every green trait in your trait pile.
worldsEnd: -1 for every green trait in your trait pile.

name: Impact Event
description: -1 Gene Pool. Discard 1 card from your hand for each dominant trait in your trait pile.
worldsEnd: -1 for each trait in your trait pile with a face value of 4 or higher.

name: Eyes Open From Behind the Stars
description: -1 Gene Pool. Discard 1 card from your hand. The player or players who discarded the lowest face value must also discard 1 trait from their trait pile.
worldsEnd: Discard your highest face value trait from your trait pile to the Old Gods.

name: Choking Vines
description: -1 Gene Pool. Ignore blue and green actions.
worldsEnd: +1 for each green trait in the trait pile to your left.

name: Jungle Rot
description: -1 Gene Pool. Ignore red and purple actions.
worldsEnd: +4 if you have 2 or fewer green traits in your trait pile.

name: Algal Superbloom
description: +0 Gene Pool. [illegible]
worldsEnd: +1 for each blue trait in the trait pile to your left.

name: Tragedy of the Commons
description: -1 Gene Pool. Choose a color in your hand to keep. Discard the rest.
worldsEnd: Discard a Drop of Life from your trait pile.

name: Sacrifice
description: -1 Gene Pool. Return a positive face value trait to your hand.
worldsEnd: +4 if you have 2 or fewer red traits in your trait pile.

name: Ancient Corruption
description: -1 Gene Pool. Discard all actions from your hand.
worldsEnd: -1 for each action in your trait pile.

name: Great Deluge
description: -1 Gene Pool. Pass all blue cards from your hand right.
worldsEnd: +4 if you have 2 or fewer blue traits in your trait pile.

name: Tropical Superstorm
description: -1 Gene Pool. Pass all colorless cards from your hand right.
worldsEnd: +1 for each purple trait in the trait pile to your left.

name: Endless Monsoon
description: -1 Gene Pool. Pass all purple cards from your hand right.
worldsEnd: -1 for each card in your hand.

name: Volcanic Winter
description: -1 Gene Pool. Discard 1 card from your hand with a face value of 4 or greater.
worldsEnd: +1 for each red trait in the trait pile to your left.

name: Strange Matter
description: -1 Gene Pool. Pass all red cards from your hand right.
worldsEnd: -2 for every Drop of Life in your trait pile.

name: Planetary Deforestation
description: -1 Gene Pool. Discard all green and red cards from your hand and stabilize.
worldsEnd: Subtract your Gene Pool from your final score.

name: Ashlands
description: -1 Gene Pool. Discard all purple and blue cards from your hand and stabilize.
worldsEnd: -4 if you have 2 or fewer purple traits in your trait pile.

name: Abyss Stares Back
description: -1 Gene Pool. Suppress all cards from your hand. Stabilize.
worldsEnd: -5 if you have 12 or more traits in your trait pile.

name: Isolation
description: -1 Gene Pool. If you hold 3 or fewer cards, suppress 1 random card in your hand and stabilize.
worldsEnd: If you hold 3 or fewer cards, add the face value of 1 card in your hand to your final score.

name: Discovery of Magic
description: -1 Gene Pool. Discard 3 from hand and stabilize. Cannot discard Mythlings.
worldsEnd: If you hold any Mythlings, add their face value to your final score.

name: Invasive Species
description: -1 Gene Pool. Pass all green cards from your hand right.
worldsEnd: Discard a card from your hand with a face value of 7 or less and add its face value to your final score.

name: Ecological Collapse
description: -1 Gene Pool. Discard 1 from your hand for each color in your trait pile.
worldsEnd: +2 for every negative face value in your trait pile.

name: Moonpocalypse
description: -2 Gene Pool. This catastrophe cannot reduce your Gene Pool lower than 4.
worldsEnd: -5 if your Gene Pool is 4 or higher.

name: Too Much Pink
description: -1 Gene Pool. Discard your hand. Draw 4 at the start of your turn.
worldsEnd: Reveal the top card of the trait deck and gain +1 for each trait of that color in your trait pile.

name: Anoxic Event
description: -1 Gene Pool. Discard all face value 3 or higher from hand, then stabilize.
worldsEnd: -7 if your trait count is higher than 20.

name: Regret
description: -1 Gene Pool. Return 1 from your trait pile to hand.
worldsEnd: Subtract the face value of 1 card in hand from your final score.

name: Planned Obsolescence
description: -1 Gene Pool. Discard 1 from hand for each Techling in your trait pile. Then draw 1 for each card you discarded.
worldsEnd: Discard 2 attachments in your trait pile.

name: Titan's Call
description: -1 Gene Pool. If you have any dominants in your trait pile, discard all but 1 from your hand.
worldsEnd: +3 if you have a dominant Mythling, Dinoling, or Techling in your trait pile. +6 if you have 2.

name: Still Water
description: -2 Gene Pool. Draw 3. Do not stabilize to end your turn this age.
worldsEnd: +8 if your Gene Pool is 1.
